Recipe: Grind the <style="highlight">iceberries</style> and <style="highlight">crystal branches</style> into powder. Mix the powder with <style="highlight">cold oil</style>, then infuse it with magic.
Usage: Keeps ice sculptures and icy coffins strong and resistant to melting.
Warning: Keep it away from open flames!
document:5:167:0.source_cn:
制作方法：将<style="highlight">疾霜冻果</style>和<style="highlight">簇晶枝</style>分别研磨成粉末，加入<style="highlight">低温清油</style>中，随后注入魔力。
使用说明：可用于保持冰雕和冰棺的坚固、不易融化。
注意：严禁接触明火！
